text: Hanuman chose Suryadeva as his Guru
to gain education.
But Surya said -
“I am constantly traveling.
How can I stop and teach you lessons?”
Then the answer Hanuman gave was not in words, he showed it in his action.
Facing Surya, traveling alongside him in the sky, he learned education from the moving Guru.
Surya did not stop.
Hanuman did not stop learning.
That is why what I like about this story is-
If there is a strong desire to learn, one adapts oneself according to the circumstances.
But the story does not end here.
After completing his education, Hanuman asked Suryadeva, “What should I give as Guru Dakshina?”
Traditional narrative says Surya asked him to protect his son Sugriva.
Later in the Ramayana, Hanuman stands as a support for Sugriva.
Through that very Sugriva, he meets Sri Rama.
Just observe that connection once:
Surya as the Guru → Supporting Sugriva as Guru Dakshina → Meeting Sri Rama through Sugriva.
Hanuman went to Surya for education.
The path shown by that Guru ultimately led him to his Rama.
🙏 Om Suryaya Namaha
Jai Hanuman.
